Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Record Class JdbcUrl

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.JdbcUrl
Record Components:
vendor - the recognised database vendor
subprotocol - the JDBC subprotocol as written (e.g. postgresql, oracle:thin)
host - the server host, or null for SQLite
port - the port (vendor default filled when omitted), or -1 for SQLite
database - the database name / Oracle service / Oracle SID / SQLite file path; may be null
params - extra connection properties, insertion-ordered and unmodifiable
oracleForm - which Oracle thin shape was used, or null for non-Oracle URLs
public record JdbcUrl(JdbcUrl.Vendor vendor, String subprotocol, String host, int port, String database, Map<String,String> params, JdbcUrl.OracleForm oracleForm) extends Record
Pure, dependency-free parser and builder for the common JDBC URL shapes. It breaks a URL into its components (subprotocol, host, port, database/service and a properties map) and rebuilds the canonical form via toString() — useful for validating connection strings, filling in vendor default ports and normalising them before handing them to JdbcService.

Recognised shapes (canonical forms round-trip through parse(u).toString()):

  • PostgreSQL: jdbc:postgresql://host:port/db?k=v&k2=v2 (default port 5432)
  • MySQL: jdbc:mysql://host:port/db?... (default 3306)
  • MariaDB: jdbc:mariadb://host:port/db?... (default 3306)
  • SQL Server: jdbc:sqlserver://host:port;databaseName=db;key=val (default 1433; ;-separated properties, database carried in databaseName)
  • Oracle thin, modern: jdbc:oracle:thin:@//host:port/service (default 1521)
  • Oracle thin, legacy: jdbc:oracle:thin:@host:port:sid (default 1521)
  • SQLite: jdbc:sqlite:/path/to/file.db (file path; no host/port)
